constraints: Minimal API/MVC JSON bodies and SignalR JsonHubProtocol only. Do not apply this binding to route/query/header/form values, MessagePack or Newtonsoft.Json protocols.

C# 15 native union and .NET 11 System.Text.Json are required by the new sample. There is no native C# 14/.NET 10 equivalent. The original .NET 10 converter preserves the same untagged wire shapes without parallel DTO endpoint routing.

Both cases are JSON objects, so token kind alone cannot select one. JsonUnionTypeStructuralClassifier classifies root property names and required properties, not values or nested content; no-match and multiple-match inputs fail. Disallow unmapped members on both cases rejects mixed/unknown shapes.
Classification is not business validation: this sample does not validate addresses, nonempty strings or ownership. Schema changes can change classification, so version the wire contract deliberately.

Minimal APIs/MVC use Web JSON defaults, which permit reading numbers from strings; overlapping numeric/string cases can therefore need a classifier even when SignalR's JSON protocol can distinguish those token kinds. This sample avoids that overlap with two distinct property names.

Structural classification scans the object and has limits: nested unions, polymorphic cases and ReferenceHandler.Preserve are not supported. No trimming/AOT or source-generation guarantee follows from these reflection-based server checks.
stabilityLimitations: The .NET 11 baseline is RC2, not GA verification. Final release artifacts must be reconciled separately.
